text:
La Gazzetta dello Sport
Inter move their King
A dizzy Saturday: There’s Lautaro against Genoa
Lazio’s leadership tested by Torino.
Endrick is possible
Milan believe and if Vinicius stays at Real Madrid…
Corriere dello Sport
Exclusive Mancini: ‘I’ll win the World Cup.’
Almost a confession of the coach who doesn’t preclude any target
“When did I regret it? Immediately.”
“Saudi Arabia? If Vialli were there, many things would have gone differently.”
“Defeats against Belgium were more useful and educational than the two against France. Clubs have no interest in the national team.”
“Only 30% Italians in Serie A: It’s embarrassing. But there are lads with enormous quality: it’s fair to make them improve in important games.”
“You must believe to obtain something. Inter are the best; Lazio won’t collapse, but I think that in the end Roma will win.”
Lazio, Gattuso is enjoying it
Rino: ‘I hope to stay at the top for a long time; I was dreaming of the fans’ return.’ Taylor out; here’s the starting attacking trident.
Inter, Chivu warms Jones up
So far, the Englishman has had no impact and is waiting for another chance. Provedel starts. Bastini out for 20 days. Juary mourned.
Tuttosport
Spalletti has multiplied attacking options: 16 different scorers already, with Yildiz and a winter reinforcement still to arrive.
The goals are here; now the hitman
In Europe, the average is even three goals per game. Ekhator opened his account too, but he’s in doubt for Como. Today is a decisive test (same for Nico). The January strategy doesn’t change: Sorloth remains the favourite despite his injury.
‘Toro, out of the tunnel!’
Chivu tries with Lautaro and Thuram, but Genoa…
Juary’s last dance
The Brazilian who made Avellino dream died at 67

בחינת כותרות העיתונים באיטליה חושפת ראיון בלעדי עם רוברטו מאנצ'יני, שבו הוא מצהיר כי יזכה בגביע העולם ודן בתחנות שונות בקריירה שלו, כולל התקופה בסעודיה. מאנצ'יני מעביר ביקורת על כך שרק שלושים אחוזים מהשחקנים בסרייה אה הם איטלקים, ומביע את דעתו על מאבק האליפות הנוכחי באיטליה.

במקביל, דיווחים נוספים מתייחסים להכנות של קבוצות שונות באיטליה כמו אינטר, לאציו ויובנטוס לקראת משחקי הליגה הקרובים, וכן לזכרו של השחקן הברזילאי ז'וארי שהלך לעולמו בגיל שישים ושבע.
